Package com.ucm.server.players

Class Spectator

java.lang.Object
com.ucm.server.players.HumanPlayer
com.ucm.server.players.Spectator
All Implemented Interfaces:
IPlayerNotificator
public class Spectator extends HumanPlayer
Represents a spectator in the poker game, allowing them to observe the game without participating as a player. This class extends HumanPlayer and implements the IPlayerInfo interface to provide information about the spectator's state and actions. Spectators can receive notifications about game events, such as table cards and game rounds, but they do not participate in betting or other player actions.
